parameters.query:
-- Clear existing chapters
DELETE FROM chapters WHERE manuscript_id = $1;

-- Insert chapters WITH content (including Prologue as 0, Epilogue as 999)
INSERT INTO chapters (manuscript_id, chapter_number, title, content, created_at)
SELECT 
  $1,
  (value->>'number')::integer,
  value->>'title',
  value->>'content',
  NOW()
FROM json_array_elements($2::json) AS value;

-- Update manuscript
UPDATE manuscripts 
SET 
  status = 'analyzing', 
  total_chapters = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_array_elements($2::json)) - 
    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_array_elements($2::json) WHERE value->>'number' = '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END -
    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_array_elements($2::json) WHERE value->>'number' = '999') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1;

-- Return stored chapters
SELECT chapter_number, title, LEFT(content, 100) as content_preview
FROM chapters
WHERE manuscript_id = $1
ORDER BY chapter_number;
